# POC flux averages
```{r}
# TODO Find a better way to exclude profiles with a clear benthic nepheloid layer in the epipelagic integration depth.
# The cdom data from the CTD does not show this and there is not turbidity data.

#  Average POC flux for a selected depth range
pocFlux.sub <- pocFlux %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% df.profile$sample_id) %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              distinct(sample_id, region.inuktitut, region, Year, Month,
                       bottom_depth_m, maxSampleDepth),
            by = "sample_id")  %>% 
  # consider only stations with at least 300m depth?
  filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300) %>% 
  # select a depth range to estimate flux from
  filter(Depth_5m >= 200 & Depth_5m < 300) 

# Look for the profiles with high POC at depth (potentially the benthic nepheloid layer )
AA <- pocFlux.sub %>% 
  mutate(dbin = if_else(Depth_5m < 220, "upper", "middle"),
         dbin = if_else(Depth_5m > 280, "lower", dbin)) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, sample_id, dbin) %>% 
  summarise(meanFlux = mean(ModelFlux),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = dbin, values_from = meanFlux) %>% 
  filter((lower > (upper * 3)) | (upper > 300 & lower > 700))
# Specific for the NOW profiles
BB <- pocFlux.sub %>% 
  filter(region == "North Water Polynya") %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= 200 & Depth_5m < 300) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(meanFlux = mean(ModelFlux),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(meanFlux > 300)

# Remove the potential profiles at BNL
pocFlux.sub <- pocFlux.sub %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% AA$sample_id) %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% BB$sample_id)

# Check profiles
ggplot(pocFlux.sub, aes(x = Depth_5m, y = ModelFlux,
                        group = sample_id)) +
  geom_line() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free")


pocFlux.ave <- pocFlux.sub %>% 
  # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(sample_id, region.inuktitut, Year, Month,
           bottom_depth_m, maxSampleDepth) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_model = mean(ObsFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_error = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Convert to annual flux... 
  # The observations are the average for only Jul-October (4 months), the rest of the year, the primary production is lower and POC flux is likely much lower
  
  # Use the observations as the productive period which is6 months (May-October) for full POC value. Assume that the winter period has 1/4 of the flux of the productive period? ... or not include that at all.
  mutate(poc_model_184 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000), 
         poc_error_184 = (poc_error * 184 / 1000),
         poc_model_365 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 181 / 1000),
         poc_error_365 = (poc_error * 184 / 1000) + (poc_error/4 * 181 / 1000)) 



# Pairwise matching of POC flux and lipid flux
AA <- df.profile %>% 
  # calculate the total C flux if Calanus spp + >3mm copepods
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2_3mm = sum(total_gC_flux_m2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% pocFlux.ave$sample_id) %>% 
  select(sample_id, total_gC_flux_m2, total_gC_flux_m2_3mm)

pocFlux.ave <- pocFlux.ave %>% 
  left_join(AA, by = join_by(sample_id))

# Pairwise comparison
ggplot(pocFlux.ave, 
       aes(x = poc_model, y = total_gC_flux_m2, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model-poc_error,
                    xmax = poc_model+poc_error)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  xlab("POC flux (UVP6 200-300m)\n(g C m-2 y-1)") + 
  ylab("Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)")


# Distribution of the modeled POC flux out of 200-300m
ggplot(pocFlux.ave, aes(x = region.inuktitut,
                        y = poc_model_184)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("POC Flux (g C m-2 y-1)")


# Region-average comparison
pocFlux.region <- pocFlux.ave %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(poc_model_184_mean = mean(poc_model_184),
            poc_error_184_mean = mean(poc_error_184),
            poc_model_184_sd = sd(poc_model_184),
            poc_error_184_sd = sd(poc_error_184),
            n = n(),
            total_gC_flux_m2_mean = mean(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_3mm_mean = mean(total_gC_flux_m2_3mm),
            total_gC_flux_m2_sd = sd(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_3mm_sd = sd(total_gC_flux_m2_3mm),
            poc_model_365_mean = mean(poc_model_365),
            poc_error_365_mean = mean(poc_error_365),
            poc_model_365_sd = sd(poc_model_365),
            poc_error_365_sd = sd(poc_error_365),
            .groups = "drop")
  
  
ggplot(pocFlux.region, 
       aes(x = poc_model_184_mean, y = total_gC_flux_m2_mean, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model_184_mean-poc_error_184_mean,
                    xmax = poc_model_184_mean+poc_error_184_mean)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = total_gC_flux_m2_mean-total_gC_flux_m2_sd,
                    ymax = total_gC_flux_m2_mean+total_gC_flux_m2_sd),
                linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "black") +
  geom_abline() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,2), limits = c(0, 38), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  # scale_x_log10() +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region") +
  xlab("POC flux (UVP6 200-300m)\n(g C m-2 y-1)") + 
  ylab("Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)")

ggsave("figures/Fig6_lipid_gravity_comparison_20260203.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

```
# With historical POC flux from literature
```{r}
sedTrap <- read.csv("data/Sediment_trap_literature_20251117.csv") %>% 
  # Remove the anomalously high value for Mackenzie shelf
  filter(Daily_Flux != 7000) %>% 
  filter(VarCode %notin% c("FPOC","60-80umPOC","80-100umPOC",
                                  "100-120POC","120POC",
                                  "MaxTPOC","MeanTPOC"))

# Annual averages
sedTrap_annual <- sedTrap %>% 
  mutate(Annual_Flux = as.numeric(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  group_by(RefID) %>% 
  mutate(RefID = if_else(RefID == "Hargaveetal2002", 
                         "Hargave et al. (2002): Pikialasorsuaq", RefID),
         RefID = if_else(RefID == "Lalandeetal2009", 
                         "Lalande et al. (2009): Arctic", RefID),
         RefID = if_else(RefID == "AtkinsonWacasey1987",
                         "Atkinson & Wacasey (1987): Frobisher Bay", RefID )) %>% 
  # Frobisher Bay near Iqualuit (no clear native name)
  summarise(flux_mean = mean(Annual_Flux, na.rm = T),
            flux_sd = sd(Annual_Flux, na.rm = T),
            min = min(Annual_Flux),
            max = max(Annual_Flux),
            depth_mean = mean(Depth_m, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  # mutate(label = paste(RefID, AreaCode, sep = " - "))

ggplot(sedTrap_annual, 
       aes(y = RefID, x = flux_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = min, xend = max)) +
  xlab("POC flux (g C m-2 y-1)") +
    geom_text(aes(label = RefID), 
              vjust = -1, hjust = 0.2,  size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,2), limits = c(0, 38), expand = c(0,0))
```

# TODO Group POC flux by profile groups
```{r}
# If lipid flux is based on direct average of all profiles
profile_totals_5m <- profile_sums_m2 %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id)


pocFlux.pgs <- pocFlux %>% 
  left_join(profile_sums_m2 %>% 
              distinct(sample_id, profile_group, region.inuktitut, sample_cruise),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(profile_group)) %>% 
  
  # average by profile group
  group_by(sample_cruise, Depth_5m, profile_group, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(mean_volume_L = mean(Sampled_volume_L, na.rm = T),
            total_volume_L = sum(Sampled_volume_L, na.rm = T),
            mean_model_flux = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            mean_flux_err = mean(fluxErr, na.rm = T),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Average by 100 m bins
pocFlux.pgs_100m <- pocFlux.pgs %>% 
  # filter(mean_model_flux < 500) %>%  # TODO verify
  mutate(depth100 = floor(Depth_5m/100)*100+100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_cruise, depth100, profile_group, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(mean_model_flux = mean(mean_model_flux),
            mean_flux_err = mean(mean_flux_err),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(cr_pgs = paste0(sample_cruise,profile_group))

# plot flux per region...
ggplot(pocFlux.pgs_100m, aes(x = as.factor(depth100),
                        y = mean_model_flux)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  ylab("POC Flux (mg C m-2 d-1)")

ggplot(pocFlux.pgs_100m, aes(x = as.factor(depth100),
                        y = mean_model_flux,
                        group = cr_pgs)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  ylab("POC Flux (mg C m-2 d-1)")


```

# Calculate regional flux
```{r}

# POC flux, get average flux at depth range of 200-300 m
# values in mg C m-2 d-1
df_poc_flux <- pocFlux.pgs %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= 200 & Depth_5m <= 300) %>% 
  group_by(sample_cruise, region.inuktitut, profile_group) %>% 
  summarise(poc_model = mean(mean_model_flux, na.rm = T),
            poc_error = mean(mean_flux_err, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Convert to annual flux... 
  # TODO temporary and should not simply be *365 because of interannual variability
  # mutate(poc_model = poc_model * 365 / 1000,
  #        poc_error = poc_error * 365 / 1000) %>% 
  # The observations are the average for only Jul-October (4 months), the rest of the year, the primary production is lower and POC flux is likely much lower
  
# TODO actually change to 6 months (May-October) for full POC value
  mutate(poc_model = (poc_model * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 181 / 1000),
         poc_error = (poc_error * 184 / 1000) + (poc_error/4 * 181 / 1000))


ggplot(df_poc_flux, aes(x = region.inuktitut,
                        y = poc_model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("POC Flux (g C m-2 y-1)")
```
